title: fix(plugin-form): a create form offers a state_machine select only its initialStates
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8CD9CXukrjPYCaAJupMsVw)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新建表单里受 `state_machine` 管辖的下拉字段，现在只列出该状态机声明的 `initialStates`（如 showcase 项目只给「Planned」），与编辑表单已有的「只给可达状态」走同一道字段门。
- **为什么改**：服务端新建时只接受 `initialStates`，表单却列出全部选项，用户选别的值点保存才收到 `invalid_initial_state` 拒绝；按分诊「先改平台」裁定，在表单层修好，所有应用的新建表单一起受益。
- **风险与回滚**：只收窄选项列表、不改写任何值；没有声明 `initialStates` 的状态机、warning 级或仅 update 的规则保持全部选项；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/stateMachineOptions.ts`（create 分支与「打开值保留」规则）、`ui/packages/core/src/validation/validators/state-machine-next-values.ts`（新 helper）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`（gateFields 下移以拿到打开值）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/stateMachineCreateSelect-27763.test.tsx`，预期 6 条全绿（主从表单、平铺表单、新建对话框都只给 `planned`）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27763

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `@object-ui/core` gains `stateMachineInitialValues(objectSchema, fieldName)` beside `stateMachineNextValues`: the values a new record may be created in, read from the same served `validations` with the same rule reading (blocking `severity: 'error'`, `active`, `events` covering the write, absent keys read as the spec default). It returns `null` when no applicable rule declares `initialStates`, which is exactly where the server's insert check is a no-op. The two helpers now share one rule predicate, so there is still one reading of a machine.
- `narrowStateMachineOptions` (the pass inside `gateFormFields`, which every form layout draws through) gains a create arm: on `mode: 'create'` a select governed by such a machine keeps only its `initialStates`. The edit arm is unchanged.
- The value a create form OPENS with (`openingValues`: the seeded `default: true` option or the caller's pre-fill) stays offered even when it lies outside `initialStates`, so the form never silently drops a value it was handed; the server's refusal stays the one that names it. Every layout passes the values it opens with: `ObjectForm` (its gate step moves below `finalDefaultValues` for that), `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`, `TabbedForm`, `WizardForm`.
- The master-detail form needs no path of its own: its header is an `ObjectForm`, so it draws through the same gate (measured: the master-detail test below goes red under the ablation with the others).
- When no field narrows, the pass returns the very array it was handed, as before.
- The behaviour is written down in `ui/packages/plugin-form/README.md` and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` (neither described the edit-side narrowing before).

## Why

`showcase_project`'s `project_status_flow` declares `initialStates: ['planned']`, and the server refuses any other initial status with `invalid_initial_state`. The "New Project + Tasks" create form offered all five statuses, so four of them were dead ends. The triage ruled platform first: the form stops offering what the server refuses, for every app, and the showcase page stays as it is as the proof. `examples/app-showcase/**` is untouched.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/state-machine-next-values.test.ts`: `stateMachineInitialValues` (package-root export, declared states, absent `events`, no or empty `initialStates`, warning / inactive / update-only rules, another field, intersection of two rules).
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/stateMachineOptions.test.ts`: the create arm on both option carriers, the opening value kept, the persisted record ignored on create, the no-`initialStates` control, the edit control, a `view` form, and through `gateFormFields`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/stateMachineCreateSelect-27763.test.tsx` (DOM, read off the native select Radix renders): the showcase master-detail create form, the flat in-page create form and the console create dialog each offer only `planned`; a caller's pre-fill outside `initialStates` stays offered; CONTROL: no `initialStates` keeps every option; CONTROL: an edit form still narrows from the stored value.
- `ui/e2e/live/master-detail.spec.ts`: one new case opens the status select on the live showcase page and asserts `planned` is offered and the four refused states are not. The existing cases are unchanged apart from one comment.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, on the committed tree)</summary>

Via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock; `@object-ui/core` and the plugin-form sources resolve to `src/` through the ui vitest alias, so no dist rebuild sits in the path.

1. Create arm off (`if (mode === 'create') {` replaced so it never matches): 8 failed, 16 passed of the two files. Red: the 4 create-arm unit cases and the 4 DOM create cases (master-detail, flat, dialog, pre-fill). Green: both CONTROLs and every edit case. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. Opening value dropped (`return initial && opening !== null ? new Set([...initial, opening]) : initial;` replaced by `return initial;`): 2 failed, 22 passed. Red: exactly the two pre-fill cases. Restored the same way.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Seeded default: the showcase status field's `default: true` option is `planned`, which is inside `initialStates`, so the master-detail form opens on a legal value. A seeded default outside `initialStates` would stay offered (the opening-value rule) and the server would refuse it on save; no showcase object has one today.
- The master-detail child rows (`showcase_task`) are not narrowed on create: `task_status_flow` is update-only and declares no `initialStates`, so the server does not police their insert either.
- Create surfaces outside the form gate (a grid's inline new row, a board's quick-create) are not changed here; this PR covers the form layouts that draw through `gateFormFields`. Filed by the seat as #27976.
- Mode: the create arm keys on `mode: 'create'`, the value every create form in the console and the showcase page declares. A form that declares no mode keeps every option, as before.
- The live e2e case is measured by CI's `Live E2E UI` job, not locally.
